title: g8s vendored skills manifest
description: Operator skills shipped with the g8s repository. Each entry is a loadable skill directory: copy (or symlink) it into your agent platform's skill directory (e.g. ~/.agents/skills/) to install. Version and changelog live inside each SKILL.md frontmatter.

skills.name: g8s-supervisor
skills.description: Charter for operating g8s as the canonical supervisor: bounded worker dispatch (agy et al.) with supervisor and worker roles, multi-worker multi-role fan-out per task, evidence-verified acceptance, and leak-free upstream reporting.

skills.name: g8s-blind-verifier
skills.description: Double-blind counterexample & falsification review operating exclusively on BlindReviewPacket (SpecContract + Invariants + RawGitDiff + MechanicalTestOutput), stripping worker self-report and model identity to defeat reviewer sycophancy.

skills.name: g8s-red-prove
skills.description: Mechanical Red -> Green reproduction + property/mutation proof + Seeded Mutant Canary verification (--canary-mutant) to eliminate vacuous tests and phantom bugfixes.

skills.name: g8s-scenario-matrix
skills.description: 12-dimension edge-case, concurrency, and failure-injection generator and holdout verifier defeating test suite overfitting and AI blindspots.

skills.name: g8s-ux-visual-gate
skills.description: Headless browser DOM bounding-box collision, computed typography/contrast, console runtime error, keyboard navigation, and media playback contract verifier.

skills.name: g8s-sec-gate
skills.description: Zero-trust SAST and live DAST probe runner enforcing SSRF private-IP blocking, path traversal containment, CSP/XSS sanitization, auth bypass probing, and trust boundary integrity.

skills.name: g8s-epistemic-audit
skills.description: Claim decomposition and evidence-tier classifier (MECHANICAL_VERIFIED, OBSERVATIONAL_TELEMETRY, UNVERIFIED_PROSE), enforcing the 4 epistemic laws across supervisor handoffs and receipts.

skills.name: g8s-mobile-gate
skills.description: Android/iOS mobile emulator perception & action verification gate (Artemis-compatible ADB/xcrun UI hierarchy dump, screenshot capture, exclusive DeviceLeasePool locking, and ANR/crash logcat trapping).
